# Link Sense Favicon Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Give the showcase site a theme-aware SVG favicon with ICO and Apple-touch fallbacks, linked from the page and included in the Pages deploy.

**Architecture:** A hand-written `favicon.svg` is the primary icon. A small Pillow script draws `favicon.ico` and `apple-touch-icon.png` from the same geometry; the generated files are committed so CI needs nothing new. Node tests read the file headers directly (no dependencies), and the existing deploy test is updated for the new staged files.

**Tech Stack:** SVG, Python 3 with Pillow (run by hand only), Node built-in test runner, GitHub Actions workflow edit.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-14-favicon-design.md`

## Global Constraints

- Mark: rounded square (corner radius 14 on a 64×64 canvas) with a white bookmark ribbon. Ribbon points on the 64 canvas: `(20,12) (44,12) (44,48) (32,40) (20,48)`.
- SVG colours: light `#0f766e` background / `#ffffff` ribbon; dark (`prefers-color-scheme: dark`) `#5fd0c4` background / `#06201d` ribbon.
- `favicon.ico` contains exactly three images: 16×16, 32×32, 48×48. `apple-touch-icon.png` is 180×180.
- The SVG has `viewBox="0 0 64 64"` and contains no `<script`, no `href=`, no `url(`, and no reference to any host other than the `xmlns` namespace.
- No new CI step, no new dependency in `site/`, no build step. The generator script is run by hand and is not part of the workflow.
- The three icon files live in `site/` and are named exactly `favicon.svg`, `favicon.ico`, `apple-touch-icon.png`.
- The deploy workflow's staging `cp` line must copy all eight publishable files: `index.html styles.css demo.js CNAME .nojekyll favicon.svg favicon.ico apple-touch-icon.png`.
- Head links, in this order: `<link rel="icon" href="favicon.svg" type="image/svg+xml">`, `<link rel="icon" href="favicon.ico" sizes="48x48">`, `<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="apple-touch-icon.png">`.
- Nothing is pushed to GitHub by this plan.

## Review Focus

1. **Deploy leaves an icon out** — the live site would 404 on `/favicon.ico` and the touch icon (Task 2, workflow `cp` test).
2. **Malformed ICO or PNG** — a corrupt header makes browsers silently ignore the icon (Task 1, header tests for PNG size, ICO count and sizes).
3. **iOS black corners** — a transparent touch icon renders with black corners, so the PNG must be opaque (Task 1, PNG colour-type test).
4. **SVG pulls in anything external or executable** — scripts, links or `url()` to another resource (Task 1, SVG scan test).
5. **Dark-mode variant missing or unreadable** — the SVG must carry both colour sets so the tab icon stays visible on a dark browser theme (Task 1, SVG colour test).

## File Structure

| File | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `site/favicon.svg` | Primary, theme-aware icon |
| `scripts/make-favicons.py` | Draws `favicon.ico` and `apple-touch-icon.png` (run by hand) |
| `site/favicon.ico`, `site/apple-touch-icon.png` | Generated fallbacks, committed |
| `site/test/favicon.test.mjs` | Tests for the three icon files |
| `site/index.html` | The three head links |
| `.github/workflows/pages.yml` | Stages the icon files |
| `site/test/site.test.mjs`, `site/test/workflow.test.mjs` | Updated for the links and the staged files |

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing tests**

Create `site/test/favicon.test.mjs`:

```js
import test from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import path from "node:path";

const siteDir = path.dirname(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)));
const read = (name) => readFileSync(path.join(siteDir, name));

test("favicon.svg has the 64x64 viewBox and both colour variants", () => {
  const svg = read("favicon.svg").toString("utf8");
  assert.match(svg, /^<svg[^>]*xmlns="http:\/\/www\.w3\.org\/2000\/svg"/);
  assert.match(svg, /viewBox="0 0 64 64"/);
  assert.match(svg, /<\/svg>\s*$/);
  for (const colour of ["#0f766e", "#ffffff", "#5fd0c4", "#06201d"]) {
    assert.ok(svg.toLowerCase().includes(colour), `missing colour ${colour}`);
  }
  assert.match(svg, /prefers-color-scheme:\s*dark/);
});

test("favicon.svg contains nothing executable or external", () => {
  const svg = read("favicon.svg").toString("utf8");
  assert.equal(/<script/i.test(svg), false);
  assert.equal(/\bhref\s*=/i.test(svg), false);
  assert.equal(/url\(/i.test(svg), false);
  const hosts = [...svg.matchAll(/https?:\/\/[^\s"')]+/g)].map((m) => m[0]);
  assert.deepEqual(hosts, ["http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"]);
});

test("apple-touch-icon.png is a 180x180 opaque RGB PNG", () => {
  const png = read("apple-touch-icon.png");
  assert.deepEqual([...png.subarray(0, 8)], [0x89, 0x50, 0x4e, 0x47, 0x0d, 0x0a, 0x1a, 0x0a]);
  assert.equal(png.toString("ascii", 12, 16), "IHDR");
  assert.equal(png.readUInt32BE(16), 180);
  assert.equal(png.readUInt32BE(20), 180);
  assert.equal(png[25], 2, "colour type 2 = RGB without alpha, so iOS shows no black corners");
});

test("favicon.ico holds exactly the 16, 32 and 48 pixel images", () => {
  const ico = read("favicon.ico");
  assert.equal(ico.readUInt16LE(0), 0, "reserved");
  assert.equal(ico.readUInt16LE(2), 1, "type 1 = icon");
  const count = ico.readUInt16LE(4);
  assert.equal(count, 3);
  const sizes = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
    const entry = 6 + i * 16;
    const width = ico[entry] || 256;
    const height = ico[entry + 1] || 256;
    assert.equal(width, height);
    const bytes = ico.readUInt32LE(entry + 8);
    const offset = ico.readUInt32LE(entry + 12);
    assert.ok(bytes > 0 && offset + bytes <= ico.length, `image ${i} lies inside the file`);
    sizes.push(width);
  }
  assert.deepEqual(sizes.sort((a, b) => a - b), [16, 32, 48]);
});
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Write the generator**

Create `scripts/make-favicons.py`:

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Draw site/favicon.ico and site/apple-touch-icon.png from the shared mark geometry.

The geometry and colours match site/favicon.svg and
docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-14-favicon-design.md. Run by hand from the
repository root when the mark changes:

    python3 scripts/make-favicons.py

The generated files are committed; CI never runs this script.
"""
import sys
from pathlib import Path

try:
    from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
except ImportError:
    sys.exit("Pillow is required to regenerate the favicons: pip install pillow")

SITE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "site"

BACKGROUND = "#0f766e"
RIBBON = "#ffffff"
CORNER_RADIUS = 14  # in units of the 64x64 canvas
RIBBON_POINTS = [(20, 12), (44, 12), (44, 48), (32, 40), (20, 48)]
SUPERSAMPLE = 8


def draw_mark(size: int, rounded: bool) -> Image.Image:
    """Draw the mark at `size` px. `rounded=False` gives an opaque full-bleed square."""
    big = size * SUPERSAMPLE
    unit = big / 64
    if rounded:
        image = Image.new("RGBA", (big, big), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    else:
        image = Image.new("RGB", (big, big), BACKGROUND)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(image)
    if rounded:
        draw.rounded_rectangle([0, 0, big - 1, big - 1], radius=CORNER_RADIUS * unit, fill=BACKGROUND)
    draw.polygon([(x * unit, y * unit) for x, y in RIBBON_POINTS], fill=RIBBON)
    return image.resize((size, size), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)


def main() -> None:
    # iOS rounds the touch icon itself and paints transparent corners black, so keep it opaque.
    draw_mark(180, rounded=False).save(SITE / "apple-touch-icon.png", optimize=True)
    draw_mark(256, rounded=True).save(SITE / "favicon.ico", sizes=[(16, 16), (32, 32), (48, 48)])
    print(f"wrote {SITE / 'apple-touch-icon.png'} and {SITE / 'favicon.ico'}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

test("the head links the SVG icon, the ICO fallback and the touch icon, in that order", () => {
  const head = html.slice(html.indexOf("<head>"), html.indexOf("</head>"));
  const svg = head.indexOf('<link rel="icon" href="favicon.svg" type="image/svg+xml">');

  assert.ok(svg > -1 && ico > -1 && touch > -1, "all three icon links must be present");
  assert.ok(svg < ico && ico < touch, "SVG first so supporting browsers prefer it");
});
